name: Milpitas Police Explorers
what_you_do: Learn about police work. You get hands-on training, go to meetings twice a month, help at town events and ride with officers.
who_can_apply: The city page says ages 14 to 20 in one place and 16 to 20 in another, so ask. You need at least a 2.0 GPA, no major criminal convictions, and no substance abuse. You do not have to live in Milpitas.
duration: Ongoing, with meetings twice a month.
deadline_text: No application dates are stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Get the Explorer form, the history form and the health form from the page. Or pick up a form at the police station, 1275 N Milpitas Blvd. You must pass a talk with officers and a background check. Call 408-586-2400 with questions.
notes: The info sheet on the page is from 2010. It still names the Boy Scouts as a sponsor. Call 408-586-2400 to check that the program takes new members.
